entries.modelStatsHitUnreportedTip: Zero cache hits on long calls may mean a relay removed cache fields. All-miss cost is an upper bound; check with the direct API.
entries.modelStatsEmpty: No usage data for this period.
entries.modelStatsNote: Hit rate = cache reads ÷ (reads + uncached input). “Unreported?” means cache data may be missing, so cost is an upper bound. Unit price = cost ÷ tokens × 1M; value = tokens ÷ cost.
entries.sessionLineSplit: This session {amount} (API) · Plan equiv. {planAmount} · Hit {hitRate} · Input {input} · Cache {cache} · Output {output}
entries.planStatsTitle: Token Plan usage stats (per-1% & full-window estimates)
entries.planStatsEmpty: No Coding Plan quota data yet. Enable and refresh a provider under Quotas.
entries.planStatsCurveTitle: Plan usage curves (aggregated from sample intervals)
entries.planStatsCurveEmpty: Not enough samples: refresh successfully twice with a quota percentage change.
entries.planStatsNote: Amounts are catalog-price equivalents. Plans use quota; budgets count API only. Estimates cover dsh calls, while server percentages cover the account. Short samples are less precise. 5h rolls; week/month use local dates.
entries.catalogDisplayHint: Controls direct display in the price table; mounting and billing stay unchanged. Hidden cards stay reachable in the table.
entries.priceTableDisplayHint: Expand a vendor group to edit prices; restore unmounted bundled models below.
entries.priceMultiplyAll: Changing the multiplier applies to all rates for this model
entries.priceMultiplySingle: Change this rate only; uncheck to restore the shared multiplier
entries.priceMultiplyInvalid: Enter a non-negative rate or multiplication, e.g. 2 × 0.8
